image_description: The image displays two white weasels (likely stoats or ermines in winter coat) on a paved brick path. The background features a grassy field and large multi-story buildings, suggesting an urban park or coastal town setting. One weasel is in the foreground, sniffing the ground, while the other is further back, appearing to run or leap. Both animals exhibit the characteristic elongated body and short legs of mustelids.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The fur texture appears slightly overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the fine individual hair strands expected in a high-resolution macro shot. It has a 'airbrushed' AI aesthetic.

The perspective of the brick path and the buildings in the background feels slightly warped. The bricks in the mid-ground lose definition abruptly, and the building lines don't converge perfectly naturally, suggesting a generative depth error.

The paws of the weasel in the background are indistinct and seem to merge slightly with the ground or blur out, lacking clear digit definition. This is a common AI artifact where extremities lose coherence.
